title: Cobbleforge
description: A Cobblemon adventure server with gyms, badges, events, and zero pay-to-win nonsense.
body:
🐾 Full Pokédex
Catch, train, evolve, and battle all 1025 Pokémon in a fully featured Cobblemon experience.
🏆 Gyms & Badge League
Challenge Gym Leaders, earn badges, and climb your way toward becoming Champion.
🌍 Custom World
Explore Terralith biomes, handcrafted structures, and themed regions built for adventure.
⚔️ Mega Evolutions & Advanced Combat
Take battles further with Mega Evolutions, enhanced mechanics, and competitive depth.
🧭 Quality-of-Life Focused
Waystones, minimap, UI tweaks, storage upgrades, and smart QoL mods for smooth gameplay.
🎨 Immersion & Visuals
Decor mods, animations, shaders support, custom music, and sound improvements.
⚡ Optimized Performance
Built with Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, and culling for smooth, stable performance.
💎 Fair & Balanced
Zero pay-to-win. Progression comes from effort, exploration, and skill — not cash.
